descriptor.label: COBOL Copybook
descriptor.description: Export as a COBOL copybook record layout (.cpy) from any source.

include_comments.description: Emit a header comment block in the generated copybook.
include_comments.title: Include Comments

fixed_format.description: Fixed-format layout (code in columns 8-72, long entries continued on the next line); `false` writes free format with no column limits.
fixed_format.title: Fixed Format

numeric_usage.description: `comp`: binary integers (`COMP`), packed decimals (`COMP-3`) and floats (`COMP-1`/`COMP-2`); `display`: zoned decimal numbers. Applies to a source that is not a copybook.
numeric_usage.title: Numeric Usage

default_string_length.description: Length of text with no maxLength (`PIC X(n)`).
default_string_length.title: Default String Length

default_occurs.description: Maximum occurrences of a list with no maxItems (`OCCURS … TO n`).
default_occurs.title: Default Occurs

decimal_scale.description: Digits after the decimal point of a decimal with no multipleOf (`S9(p)V9(s)`).
decimal_scale.title: Decimal Scale
